_README: The registrant boundary register. `Company(ticker)` resolves only the CURRENT
registrant, so a predecessor's decade of filings is invisible with no error and no gap
signal -- APA arrives with 22 filings where its peers have 62 and nothing says why.
`cutover_date` means: THE FIRST DATE ON WHICH THE SUCCESSOR IS THE REPORTING
REGISTRANT. Predecessor filings are kept strictly BEFORE it, successor filings on or
after it, so the two sets are disjoint by construction. That is deliberately NOT a
union of the two CIKs: Apache Corp kept filing its own 10-K/10-Q through 2024-11-07
because it retains registered public debt, so a union would double-cover 2021-2024
with two DIFFERENT legal entities -- ~15 duplicated filings and a subsidiary's
statements blended into the parent's. A fuller-looking history that is quietly wrong is
the dangerous direction, which is why this register is dated rather than additive.
A RENAME IS NOT A CUTOVER AND BELONGS NOWHERE IN THIS FILE. CVS Caremark -> CVS Health
and Facebook -> Meta keep their CIK; an entry for either would walk one CIK twice and
duplicate every filing. `kind` may only be `reorganisation` or `domestication`, and the
loader rejects `kind: rename` by name so the mistake cannot be made quietly.
A curated JSON rather than an `sp500_tickers` column: that table is rebuilt from
Wikipedia, so a roster refresh would silently overwrite hand-established evidence.
Every figure below was measured against live EDGAR on 2026-08-23 and each split
produced 0 duplicate accessions and no gap at the boundary. Phase 5b's
`filing_continuity` check is the standing enforcement: once this register is in place,
the only acceptable short histories are VRT's 2018 SPAC listing and META's 2012 IPO,
so any other truncation it reports is a MISSING ENTRY HERE, i.e. a work item.

APA.evidence: Apache Corp (CIK 6769) became a subsidiary of the new holding company APA Corp (CIK 1841666) in the reorganisation effective 2021-03-01. Measured 2026-08-23: 125 predecessor 10-K/10-Q filings before the date (1994-03-21 .. 2021-02-26) and 22 successor filings after (2021-05-07 ..), 0 duplicate accessions, no gap -- the 2021-02-26 10-K is followed directly by the 2021-05-07 10-Q. CRITICAL: Apache Corp continued filing its OWN 10-K/10-Q through 2024-11-07 as a subsidiary with registered public debt, so those ~15 filings are correctly EXCLUDED by the date test; admitting them would blend a subsidiary's statements with the parent's.
APA._expect: APA's Phase 3/4/4b numbers all move and that is not a regression: it currently carries 22 filings, none before 2021, and should reach the ~62 every other in-sample ticker has. Its pre-2021 Apache Corp filings may resolve totalRevenue on concepts the 2021+ filings never use, so the `apa:RevenuesAndOther` result (71 rows, $596M-12,132M) becomes a SUBSET of a longer series. Re-baseline deliberately.

GOOGL.evidence: Google Inc (CIK 1288776) became a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc (CIK 1652044) on 2015-10-02, when the holding-company structure took effect. Measured 2026-08-23: 48 predecessor filings before the date (2004-08-16 .. 2015-07-23) and 46 successor filings after (2015-10-29 ..), 0 duplicate accessions, no gap at the Q3-2015 boundary.
GOOGL._expect: Recovers 2011-2015, which Phase 9's out-of-sample roster lists as a known truncation.

ETN.evidence: Eaton Corp (Ohio, CIK 31277) re-registered as Eaton Corp plc (Ireland, CIK 1551182) in the 2012 Cooper Industries transaction. The date is set at 2012-11-01 rather than the transaction's own late-November closing because the successor's FIRST filing is the 2012-11-14 10-Q while the predecessor's LAST is the 2012-10-31 10-Q: 2012-11-01 is the only boundary that is both gapless and non-overlapping. Measured 2026-08-23: 78 predecessor filings (1994-03-28 .. 2012-10-31), 56 successor filings (2012-11-14 ..), 0 duplicate accessions. Unlike APA, the predecessor stopped filing entirely, so there is no subsidiary double-coverage to exclude.
ETN._expect: Recovers the pre-domestication decade, including the 2012 filings whose `fp='FY'` runs 370 and 97 days -- the in-sample calendar edge case ETN is on the roster for.
